description: Compares groups of numbers as box plots on one shared horizontal axis: per group a box from the lower to the upper quartile, a line at the median, whiskers to the furthest numbers within 1.5 times the box length, and dots for the outliers beyond. The quartiles come from d3-array quantileSorted and the axis from d3 nice() and ticks(), computed on the server, so there is no script. A hidden table gives each group's count, minimum, quartiles, median, maximum and outlier count. Motion-ready: each group fades in through --k from --p (build progress 0 to 1, default 1); the standalone render is the finished picture and reduced motion shows the end state.
